meta.title: HPE brand and accent
meta.description: Restyles the Web UI in HPE terms: HPE green for the primary button, switches, checkboxes, focus rings, links, the slot caret and the selection wash, the HPE brand element beside the sidebar wordmark and before the blank-session headline, and a two-tone HPE wordmark. The accent arrives as a removable token layer, so the light and dark palettes underneath stay intact; disable the plugin to return to the shipped DeepSeek look.
